summary: 仅比较嗅觉脑区所占比例或受体数量，会低估人鼻的能力。实验证明，人们未必意识到闻到什么，行为和判断却已受到影响，训练和早期经历也能改变气味辨别与记忆。
logic: 回顾人类嗅觉较弱的旧看法
以灵敏度实验重新评价
观察气味对行为和判断的影响
解释训练、情绪及童年记忆

paragraphs.brief: 传统上，嗅觉并不是感官研究的先锋，而是偏向于看来更重要的视觉和听觉。
sentences: Traditionally, smell has not been at the forefront of sensory research, pushed aside in favour of the seemingly more vital senses of vision and hearing.
传统上，嗅觉并不是感官研究的先锋，而是偏向于看来更重要的视觉和听觉。
There has been a strong belief that people, especially compared to other mammals, are not that influenced by smells.
有一种强烈的信念，即人们，特别是与其他哺乳动物相比，并非受气味的影响。

paragraphs.brief: 最先断言人类嗅觉相对不重要的人之一是皮埃尔·保罗·布罗卡，他是一个19世纪有影响力的解剖学家。
sentences: One of the first to assert the relative unimportance of the human sense of smell was Pierre Paul Broca, an influential 19th-century anatomist.
最先断言人类嗅觉相对不重要的人之一是皮埃尔·保罗·布罗卡，他是一个19世纪有影响力的解剖学家。

After comparing the proportion of the brain devoted to smell in different animals, he suggested that mammals can be classed into two broad groups: macrosmatic mammals, such as dogs, have a finely tuned sense of smell which they rely on to perceive the world, while marine mammals and primates, including humans, are microsmatic – the organ with which they smell is small and functionally redundant.
在比较了大脑中用于不同动物嗅觉的比例之后，他建议将哺乳动物分为两大类：大型哺乳动物，如狗，有他们赖以感知世界的细调的嗅觉，而海洋哺乳动物和灵长类动物，包括人类，则是微量的，它们闻到的器官很小，功能上多余。

paragraphs.brief: 这一想法似乎与最近对遗传学的研究相吻合，这些研究发现，大多数哺乳动物大约有一千种不同的嗅觉受体。
sentences: That idea seemed to fit with more recent studies in genetics, which found that the majority of mammals have about one thousand different types of smell receptor.
这一想法似乎与最近对遗传学的研究相吻合，这些研究发现，大多数哺乳动物大约有一千种不同的嗅觉受体。
Most of these aren’t present in humans, who only possess four hundred or so different types.
大部分都不属于人类，人类只有四百种不同的种类。

paragraphs.brief: 尽管我们可能与其他哺乳动物相比，受体种类较少，但研究表明，人的鼻子和大脑有着异常良好的连接，每组受体连接到比其他动物更多的神经区域。
sentences: Yet these findings may have been misleading.
然而，这些调查结果可能误导了人们。
Brain scans show that more of the human brain is devoted to smell processing than Broca’s anatomical studies suggested.
脑部扫描显示，比布罗卡的解剖学研究更专注于嗅觉处理。

And although we may have fewer types of receptor than other mammals, research has shown that the human nose and brain are unusually well connected, with each group of receptors linking to many more neural regions than is the case in other animals.
尽管我们可能与其他哺乳动物相比，受体种类较少，但研究表明，人的鼻子和大脑有着异常良好的连接，每组受体连接到比其他动物更多的神经区域。
That should give us a good ability to process incoming scents.
这应该能让我们处理进气味

paragraphs.brief: 研究者开始寻找后发现鼻子的敏感度远高于它的名声
sentences: Once researchers began looking, they found the nose to be far more sensitive than its reputation suggested.
研究者开始寻找后发现鼻子的敏感度远高于它的名声
One study, for example, found that we can pick out a particular substance even when heavily diluted.
例如，一项研究发现，即使严重稀释，我们也可以选择某种物质。
In fact, a person can smell just one drop of a chemical in a large swimming pool.
事实上，一个人在大游泳池里只能闻到一滴化学物味

paragraphs.brief: 此外，随着最新发现，大脑的嗅觉中心与控制情绪、恐惧和记忆的系统紧密相连，这一点越来越明显。
sentences: What’s more, with the latest findings, it is becoming clear that the brain’s smelling centres are intimately linked to its system for controlling emotion, fear and memory.
此外，随着最新发现，大脑的嗅觉中心与控制情绪、恐惧和记忆的系统紧密相连，这一点越来越明显。
That suggests a link between smell and the way we think.
这说明气味和我们思考的方式之间有联系

One Dutch academic, for example, found that when the smell of orange, seawater or peppermint was pumped through a nightclub, those inside partied harder – they danced more, laughed more, and even thought the music was better than when there was no added scent.
例如，一位荷兰学者发现，当橘子、海水或薄荷薄荷的气味从夜总会中抽出时，那些在夜总会里的人更难参加聚会 — — 他们跳得更多，笑得更多，甚至认为音乐比没有添加气味时更好。

paragraphs.brief: 其他工作发现气味会影响我们的认知能力
sentences: Other work has found that scent can influence our cognitive skills.
其他工作发现气味会影响我们的认知能力
A study found that when men were subjected to a novel smell – either good or bad – during a task used to test decision-making skills, they performed significantly worse than normal.
一项研究发现，当男子在用来测试决策技能的任务中受到一种新奇的气味(不管是好是坏)时，他们的表现比正常要差得多。
The researchers concluded that the scent stimulated brain areas connected with emotion, making their decisions emotional rather than rational.
研究者得出结论，气味刺激了大脑与情感相关的区域，使他们的决定情绪而不是理性。

paragraphs.brief: 这种研究令人惊讶的是，95%的学科改变了他们的行为，尽管只有5%的学科意识到他们面临的气味。
sentences: The surprising thing about such studies is that up to 95% of subjects altered their behaviour, despite only 5% of them being aware of the introduced smells that they were facing.
这种研究令人惊讶的是，95%的学科改变了他们的行为，尽管只有5%的学科意识到他们面临的气味。
The question, then, is why do we pay so little conscious attention to our noses unless we smell something really strong?
那么，问题是，为什么我们不注意我们的鼻子，除非我们闻到很强烈的东西？

paragraphs.brief: 但是，有气味，大脑的焦点不一样，因而无法让我们了解某个特定区域的细节。
sentences: One vital factor is that our noses just aren’t equipped to locate the source of an odour.
一个重要因素是我们的鼻子根本无法定位出气味的来源
This makes the sense of smell fundamentally different to vision or hearing, which are built to identify sights and sounds with precision.
这使嗅觉与视觉或听觉有根本的不同，而视觉或听力是用来精确地辨别视觉和声音的。
Apparently, we become aware of something when the brain focuses on a single location, after which it picks out the details, like a familiar face, from the scene.
很明显，当大脑集中在一个地点时，我们意识到了一件事，之后，它像一个熟悉的脸孔一样，从场景中挑选出细节。
With smell, though, the brain does not focus in the same way, and so is not able to make us aware of the details relating to one particular area.
但是，有气味，大脑的焦点不一样，因而无法让我们了解某个特定区域的细节。
It’s for this reason that we can only ever pick out around four smells from a complex mixture.
我们只能从复杂的混合物中挑出四股气味。

paragraphs.brief: 然而，我们都有能力培养我们的嗅觉，但需要加以利用。
sentences: Nevertheless, we all have the capacity to train our sense of smell, but it needs to be worked at.
然而，我们都有能力培养我们的嗅觉，但需要加以利用。
Master perfumers, for instance, learn to recognise, name and imagine an extraordinary range of smells through years of practice.
例如，香水大师学会识别，命名，想象出不同寻常的气味通过多年的练习。
This is accompanied by a significant reorganisation of the olfactory areas in the brain that helps them to process the scents more efficiently.
与此同时，对大脑的嗅觉区域进行了重大重组，帮助他们更有效地处理气味。

paragraphs.brief: 闻到的味道也特别好，但实际上是一种迷思，气味会引发比其他刺激更完整的记忆。
sentences: Smells are also especially good memory evokers, but it’s actually a myth that odours trigger more complete memories than other stimuli.
闻到的味道也特别好，但实际上是一种迷思，气味会引发比其他刺激更完整的记忆。
These memories are neither more accurate nor more detailed, but they are unique in that they are more emotional.
这些记忆既不准确，也不详细，但它们是独特的，因为它们更感性。
This isn’t surprising when you consider that both emotion and smell are processed by the same areas of the brain, and there is a strong link between emotion and memory.
当你认为情绪和气味都由大脑的同一区域处理时，这并不奇怪，情感和记忆之间有着紧密的联系。

paragraphs.brief: 话说回来并非所有的味道都一样
sentences: That said, not all smell memories are equal.
话说回来并非所有的味道都一样
The link between a memory and a smell is stronger if the smell is an unpleasant rather than a pleasant one, which makes sense from an evolutionary perspective.
记忆和气味之间的联系更紧密如果气味不愉快而不是不愉快的气味，从进化的角度来说，这是有道理的。

In addition, the very first time we associate a smell with an object, it evokes a much greater response in our brains than for any encounter with the smell or object in later life, laying down stronger foundations for the memory.
此外，我们第一次将一种气味与一种物联系起来，这在我们大脑中引起比任何在后世遇到的气味或物态更强烈的反应，为记忆奠定了更牢固的基础。
That doesn’t happen with any other sense.
任何其它意义都不会发生。
Since most first encounters with a smell happen at a young age, this might explain why smells often carry us back to our childhood.
由于大多数第一次遇到的气味发生在年轻时，这也许可以解释为什么气味常常把我们带回童年。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词，可含数字。

items.en: Human vision and hearing are designed to locate exactly where stimuli are coming from.
items.zh: 人类的视觉和听力被设计为精确的定位刺激来自哪里。
items.why: 题干说视觉/听觉能“定位来源”,原文用“built…with precision” 确认该功能，与题干一致。

items.en: Even when complex multiple smells are present, most humans can identify only a few individual odours.
items.zh: 即便有复杂的多种气味大多数人都只能识别出个别的气味
items.why: 人通常只能从复杂的混合气味中辨出约四种，符合“只能辨出少数”。

items.en: Professional help is needed when a person is developing their sense of smell.
items.zh: 当一个人正在形成自己的嗅觉时，需要专业帮助。
items.why: 文章说人人都可以通过练习训练嗅觉，但没有说明必须得到专业人士协助。

items.en: Smells stimulate more precise memories than sights or sounds do.
items.zh: 闻起来比目光或声音更能刺激记忆
items.why: 题干声称“更精确”(=更准确/更细致),原文明确否定，故FALSE。

items.en: A pleasant smell creates the strongest memories.
items.zh: 香味能创造最强烈的记忆
items.why: 与题干取向相反: 原文说“不愉快更强",故 FALSE。

items.en: Sensitivity to new smells declines in adulthood.
items.zh: 成年时对新闻的敏感度下降。
items.why: 童年常是第一次接触气味的时期，这解释记忆联结，没有说明成年后对新气味的敏感度下降。

items.en: Smell-related memories can frequently evoke childhood experiences.
items.zh: 与气味有关的记忆往往会唤起童年的经历。
items.why: 许多气味最早在年幼时接触，因此气味往往能把人带回童年经验。

points: 童年常是第一次接触气味的时期，这解释记忆联结，没有说明成年后对新气味的敏感度下降。
允许数字作答。标准写法可为 400 (或 four hundred).
clauses: After comparing the proportion of the brain devoted to smell in different animals, he suggested …, have a finely tuned sense of smell which they rely on to perceive the world, while marine mammals and primates, including humans, are microsmatic – the organ with which they smell is small and functionally redundant.
“that mammals can be classed into two broad groups: macrosmatic mammals, such as dogs”补足 suggested 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 suggested 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
And …, research has shown that the human nose and brain are unusually well connected, with each group of receptors linking to many more neural regions than is the case in other animals.
连接词 although 引出“although we may have fewer types of receptor than other mammals”，说明主句的让步关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 although 把这一层关系补进去。
lead: New research reassesses the nature and importance of smell
新的研究重新评估嗅觉的性质和重要性
